statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of unexplained syncope and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
A long-term continuous ECG monitoring study (CPT 93247) is medically necessary.
The service is supported by diagnosis codes R55 and G45.9.
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-29.
The denial reason is that the time limit for filing has expired.
